name: エレガントブラウン
css: body { overflow: hidden !important; }

.roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F5E6D3, #E8D5C4); border-radius: 50%; padding: 25px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), 0 0 0 1px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2), inset 0 0 50px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); margin: 0 !important; }

.gold-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 460px; height: 460px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #D4AF37; opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; }
#roulette-svg-target { border-radius: 50%; }

.center-circle { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 140px; height: 140px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FAF0E6, #E8D5C4); border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #B8956A; box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), inset 0 3px 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5), inset 0 -3px 10px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.1); z-index: 15; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.center-ornament { width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-bottom: 8px; position: relative; }
.center-ornament::before { content: ''; position: absolute; background: #B8956A; width: 40px; height: 2px; top: 50%; left: 0; transform: translateY(-50%); }
.center-ornament::after { content: ''; position: absolute; background: #B8956A; width: 2px; height: 40px; left: 50%; top: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); }

.center-diamond { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; background: #D4AF37; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(45deg); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5); }
.center-text { font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; color: #8B7355; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.pointer { position: absolute; top: 80px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 20; }

.pointer-stem { width: 4px; height: 70px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #B8956A, #8B7355); margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 2px 0 5px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), -2px 0 5px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3); }

.pointer-top { width: 16px; height: 16px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #D4AF37, #B8956A); border-radius: 50%; margin: 0 auto 5px; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.4), inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); border: 1px solid #8B7355; }

.pointer-arrow { position: relative; top: -2px; width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 8px solid transparent; border-right: 8px solid transparent; border-top: 12px solid #8B7355; margin: 0 auto; filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.4)); }
.decorative-line { position: absolute; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #D4AF37, transparent); width: 200px; opacity: 0.4; }
.line-top { top: 70px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.line-bottom { top: 530px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 240px; height: 70px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #5A4A3A; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FAF0E6, #E8D5C4); border: 2px solid #B8956A; border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); transition: all 0.3s; letter-spacing: 5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Georgia', serif; position: absolute; top: 570px; }
#spinBtn::before { content: '◆'; position: absolute; left: 25px; color: #D4AF37; font-size: 16px; }
#spinBtn::after { content: '◆'; position: absolute; right: 25px; color: #D4AF37; font-size: 16px; }
#spinBtn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF, #FAF0E6); }
#spinBtn:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.2); }

#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #8B7355; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px #ffffff, 0 0 10px rgba(139, 115, 85, 0.3); font-family: 'Georgia', serif; position: absolute; top: 650px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(245, 230, 211, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #B8956A !important; color: #5A4A3A !important; }
